issues.title: No thin vertical stalks
issues.message: A column about 3.1 mm wide and 36.0 mm tall (11.7× taller than wide) may wobble while printing and snap off during handling.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the column to at least 2 mm, add a fillet or brace at its base, or print it lying down.

issues.title: No large spidery pieces
issues.message: This is a large part made of thin, spread-out arms (average thickness about 1.92 mm, fills 8% of its outline). Parts like this warp, break and are hard to ship.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the arms, add connecting webs, or split it into sturdier pieces.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 526 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.
